description: This file defines a Java interface 'QueryCommandAdapter' within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter' package. The interface extends a generic 'Adapter' interface specialized for Command types, providing default implementations for methods related to query command criteria and actions. It is part of the protocol adapter component in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically handling query-related command adaptations.

classes.name: QueryCommandAdapter
classes.description: A Java interface that provides an adapter for query commands, specifying criteria and actions relevant to command processing in the protocol adapter.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of TopicPath.Criterion used for querying commands, defaulting to 'COMMANDS'.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the set of TopicPath.Action for retrieve actions, defaulting to 'RETRIEVE'.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether the adapter is for responses; defaults to false.
